plan.title: Explore data structure and existing workspace artifacts
plan.description: Examine the data directory structure: count images, inspect annotations.json (number of annotations, categories, image sizes), check what's already in yolo_mc/, yolo_sc/, splits/ directories. Look at metadata.json. Understand what previous work has been done.
plan.success_criteria: Complete inventory of data, existing splits, existing YOLO format data, and understanding of annotation statistics

plan.title: Inspect annotation details, categories, and product reference images
plan.description: Deep dive into: (1) annotation fields (bbox format, corrected flag, area stats), (2) category-to-product mapping via metadata.json, (3) products/ directory structure - how many products have reference images, image types, (4) store section distribution from filenames, (5) bbox size distribution relative to image size. This combines original steps 2-4.
plan.success_criteria: Complete understanding of data format, category mapping, reference image availability, and annotation quality.

plan.title: Create train/val split, YOLO labels, evaluation function, and data.yaml
plan.description: All-in-one data prep: (1) 90/10 stratified split by image (ensuring each store section is represented), seed=42, (2) COCO-format split JSONs saved to data/train_split.json and data/val_split.json, (3) YOLO-format labels for both multi-class (356 cats) and single-class variants in data/labels_mc/ and data/labels_sc/, (4) data.yaml files for ultralytics, (5) evaluation function in utils.py computing val_score = 0.7*det_mAP@0.5 + 0.3*cls_mAP@0.5 using pycocotools. Test eval with dummy predictions to verify it works.
plan.success_criteria: Split files created, YOLO labels generated, evaluation function returns sensible scores on dummy data.

plan.title: Baseline: YOLOv8m multi-class at 640
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8m with 356 classes at 640px provides a reasonable starting baseline. Medium model balances capacity and training speed.
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m on train split with nc=356, imgsz=640, 80 epochs, default augmentation, batch=16. Evaluate on val split using our evaluation function. Record val_score, detection_mAP, classification_mAP.
plan.success_criteria: Model trains successfully and produces a non-trivial val_score (>0.05).

plan.title: YOLOv8x multi-class at 1280
plan.hypothesis: Larger model + higher resolution will improve both detection and classification on shelf images, even though most objects are large.
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x nc=356, imgsz=1280, 100 epochs, batch size auto-adjusted for GPU memory. Compare val_score to step 4 baseline.

plan.title: YOLOv8x single-class detector at 1280
plan.hypothesis: Single-class detector will have higher detection recall since it only needs to localize products, not classify among 356 categories. This becomes the detection backbone for two-stage approach.
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x nc=1, imgsz=1280, 100 epochs. Record detection_mAP@0.5 and recall. Compare detection performance to multi-class model from step 5.
plan.success_criteria: Detection mAP@0.5 and recall are higher than multi-class model's detection performance.

plan.title: Build DINOv2 embedding + kNN classification pipeline
plan.description: Implement: (1) crop extraction from training images using GT boxes at original resolution with configurable padding, (2) DINOv2-base embedding extraction for all crops, (3) gallery construction from training crops + reference product images from data/products/, (4) kNN classifier with cosine similarity. Save gallery embeddings to disk for fast reuse. Include a classify_crops() function that takes image crops and returns category predictions.
plan.success_criteria: Gallery embeddings computed and saved. Classification function works on sample crops.

plan.title: Two-stage: best detector + DINOv2 kNN classification
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2 embeddings with reference images will provide much better classification than YOLO for rare categories (41 cats with only 1 annotation), improving classification_mAP and overall val_score significantly.
plan.description: Run best single-class detector on val images, extract crops, classify with DINOv2 kNN (k=5, cosine similarity). Compute val_score. Compare to best multi-class YOLO. Also try hybrid: use YOLO class when confidence > threshold, DINOv2 otherwise.
plan.success_criteria: Two-stage val_score exceeds best multi-class YOLO val_score.

plan.title: NMS tuning, confidence thresholds, and optional SAHI
plan.hypothesis: Dense shelf images benefit from adjusted NMS thresholds. SAHI may help for the 15.8% of objects that are small/medium.
plan.description: Sweep NMS IoU {0.4,0.5,0.6,0.7} and conf threshold {0.05,0.1,0.15,0.2,0.25} on best detector. Optionally try SAHI tiled inference if small objects are being missed. Compare val_score for each configuration.
plan.success_criteria: Find optimal NMS/conf settings that improve val_score over defaults.

plan.title: kNN tuning and gallery optimization
plan.hypothesis: Optimal k, distance weighting, gallery composition, and crop padding affect classification quality significantly.
plan.description: Sweep: k={1,3,5,7,11}, distance weighting (uniform vs distance), gallery variants (crops only, refs only, both), crop padding (0%, 10%, 20%). Use best detector's val predictions. Also try DINOv2-large if it fits in memory.
plan.success_criteria: Find optimal kNN configuration that improves classification_mAP over default settings.

plan.title: Extended training and augmentation tuning for best model
plan.hypothesis: Longer training with optimized augmentation will improve the detector further.
plan.description: Train best detector config for 200 epochs with close_mosaic=30, label_smoothing=0.1. Try copy-paste augmentation. Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves over shorter training run.

plan.title: TTA and final pipeline optimization
plan.hypothesis: Test-time augmentation and multi-crop DINOv2 embeddings add 1-2 mAP with no retraining.
plan.description: Run best pipeline with TTA (multi-scale + flip). Try multi-crop DINOv2 (average embeddings from original + padded + center-zoomed crops). Also try ensembling multi-class YOLO predictions with two-stage predictions using WBF. Measure val_score.

plan.title: Build final submission pipeline (run.py)
plan.description: Write run.py with best configuration: detector + classifier + post-processing. Ensure correct output format (COCO predictions.json), no blocked imports, total weight size < 420MB. End-to-end test on val split.
plan.success_criteria: run.py produces correct predictions.json, all constraints met, val_score matches expectations.

plan.title: Final validation and submission test
plan.hypothesis: Final submission produces correct predictions within all constraints.
plan.description: Run complete pipeline on val images simulating test conditions. Verify output format, timing, file sizes. Confirm val_score matches expectations. Make any final adjustments.
plan.success_criteria: Pipeline runs end-to-end, produces valid output, val_score is best achieved.
